summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 16, 2026, disclosing an increase in issued share capital following the exercise of employee share options. The company issued 25,000 common shares, bringing total issued share capital to US$47,170,000 divided into 47,170,000 common shares of par value US$1.00 each. No price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The transaction is a routine equity issuance to satisfy option exercises rather than a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply. Watch only for ordinary dilution and subsequent option-exercise disclosures.
